story_clusters.headline: NBP reports record 35.7 billion złoty loss while increasing gold reserves to 580 tons

Despite this, NBP increased gold reserves to 580 tons and aims for 700 tons. The bank also reported 169 billion złoty in unrealized gains on gold reserves.

developments.headline: Confederation MP displays swastika-modified Israeli flag in Sejm on Yom HaShoah; Mentzen endorses it; US Ambassador confronts

Confederation leader Mentzen posted his endorsement on social media. US Ambassador Tom Rose publicly condemned the act; Mentzen responded 'Are you threatening me?' Israeli and US embassy condemnations followed. Poland's Foreign Ministry condemned it 'in the strongest terms.' Nawrocki's spokesman offered mild criticism without naming Mentzen. Wipler (Confederation) confirmed to Gazeta Wyborcza that the act was premeditated and Mentzen knew in advance. developments.headline: Glapiński conducts first-ever NBP governor inspection of Polish gold at NY Fed vault; declares reserves safe amid geopolitical risk management
developments.summary: Following the G20 meeting in Washington, NBP Governor Glapiński visited the NY Federal Reserve vault and personally inspected Poland's gold reserves — the first such inspection by an NBP governor. He declared the reserves 'safe, complete, and properly stored,' with each bar individually marked by refiner and purity standard. The NBP disclosed Poland holds 570 tons of gold (up from 550 tons in January; 20 tons purchased in February 2026), distributed across Poland, London, and New York. Glapiński attributed the tri-location strategy explicitly to 'security reasons' linked to the geopolitical situation — a public acknowledgment of reserve geography as a defense against potential seizure risk. Poland's gold is now valued at approximately $94.9 billion.
developments.signal_category_relevance: Per §6 and §14, the NBP's gold accumulation strategy (targeting 700 tons) is documented as a monetary sovereignty assertion. Glapiński's personal physical inspection, publicly communicated, serves multiple functions: reassuring domestic publics amid geopolitical uncertainty, asserting sovereign ownership of foreign-held assets (a pointed response to the Russia precedent of frozen reserves), and positioning the NBP as managing national security risk. The continued accumulation (20 tons bought in February alone) confirms the structural gold strategy is accelerating, not plateauing. Note the irony: Glapiński, institutionally in tension with the Tusk government, is executing what is effectively government economic statecraft through the nominally independent central bank.

Tusk called it 'brazenly shameless.' Up to 30,000 Polish victims of the platform's liquidity crisis.

developments.headline: Nawrocki calls unsworn CT judges 'raptuses,' deflects to CT; 56.6% of Poles want him to complete oath ceremony; TK president files criminal complaints

IPN announcing its own excavation operations tells you what IPN wants you to know about its own activity. It may be that PiS fragmentation is driven by electoral decline and policy failures rather than by leadership succession dynamics, which would have different implications for how the fragmentation resolves. Calling the claim 'under pressure' on timing while leaving the causal model intact treats a potential model failure as a scheduling adjustment.
